# A Compilation of Baha'u'llah's Writings {.unnumbered}

All Volumes are temporarily organized in relationship with the Partial Inventory. These volumes are not final, but prioritized having access and being as few volumes as possible to have about 500,000 words each.

## [Volume 01 (1856–1867)](pages/v028-01.qmd) {.unnumbered}

About 489,000 words; 347 writings. Contains: 028 Early Baghdad Period (to 1856); 029 Middle Baghdad Period (1856–1860); 030 The Kitab-i-Iqan (The Book of Certitude), 1861; 031 Late Baghdad Period (1860–1863); 032 Writings in Baghdad (to 1863); 033 Istanbul and Early Edirne (mid-1863 to March 1866); 034 Middle Edirne (March 1866 – September 1867).
